headline: Lofi score falls 74 to 64; kids songs and lullabies added as a niche
paragraphs: Scores moved little: 5 of the 60 niches tracked yesterday changed. lofi-study-music fell 74 to 64 (breakout rate 41% to 36%), engineering rose 79 to 81, sleep-ambient fell 82 to 80, drone-light-shows 88 to 87 and career-resume-tips 74 to 73. First score: prediction-markets-explained 53.

Biggest breakout: rootha sa dil's "2026 Ultimate Mind Relaxing Lofi Beats" in sleep-ambient, 747.7x typical views (569,398 views, 4,540 subscribers). WEYVAA, with 513 subscribers, has two aviation breakouts at 634.7x and 494x. In prediction-markets-explained, 3 of the top 12 are NFL clips.

Added kids-songs-lullabies: 8 of the top 12 sleep-ambient videos are baby lullabies or kids songs, and AIR Media-Tech's September growth data ranks kids content first. Thumbnails could not be loaded today: 4 channel entries, no thumbnail tags, niche notes from titles only.
